name: Lua
runnerHint: Install LuaJIT (brew install luajit), or Lua 5.1+, or Neovim 0.9+

levelHints.Beginner: new to Lua: tables, strings, functions, modules.
levelHints.Intermediate: comfortable day to day: closures, metatables, varargs, string patterns.
levelHints.Advanced: design trade-offs: coroutines, OOP with metatables, Neovim plugin structure, game loops.
levelHints.Expert: deep language and runtime topics: performance in LuaJIT, environments, weak tables, ECS design.
